o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (armağan), ultimately a derivation of Proto-Turkic *Ar- (“gift”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish ترك (türk), from Proto-Turkic *tür(ü)k.
Internationalism; likely via Russian пролета́рий (proletárij), ultimately from Latin prōlētārius.
